scope: ResearchEditor and KnowledgeGraph portable components; synchronous legacy Editor draft delivery
independent_contracts: exact unchanged Markdown including Unicode/CRLF and unknown blocks
local edit preserves untouched neighbours; undo restores source
HTML clipboard preserves scientific atoms and supported marks
oversize and unrepresentable table updates reject without truncation
current transaction visible before immediate save
revoking host widget registry updates previews without altering draft
hypergraph incidence preserves joint and repeated ports, including cycles
bounded projection never shows partial relations or dangling endpoints

failures_and_corrections.finding: Initial split test compared serialized whitespace instead of the declared text semantics
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Use independent reparsing as text preservation oracle; no implementation exception added

failures_and_corrections.finding: Generic HTML pre parser intercepted scientific source nodes
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Higher-priority specific parse rule preserves scientific source atoms

failures_and_corrections.finding: Inline formula serializer bypassed mark serialization
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Route formula atoms through common mark handling and restrict supported marks

failures_and_corrections.finding: Initial block counter used a one-block fallback until the first transaction
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Initialize from actual document or hydrated input

failures_and_corrections.finding: DOM-only test environment provided IntersectionObserver but no viewport events
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Test explicitly uses the supported eager fallback, while browser checks cover viewport rendering

failures_and_corrections.finding: Text selection skipped an inserted atomic formula and selected the next paragraph
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Insert atomic scientific content with a NodeSelection, keeping block commands on the inserted block

failures_and_corrections.finding: MUI non-clearable selector type disallowed the null command-palette value
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Use the normal nullable, controlled action selector; no persisted option selection

limitations: Internal editor block IDs are session identities, not immutable publication anchors
Host owns revision persistence, authorisation and collaborative conflict protocol
Graph is a bounded presentation, not semantic verification or a global graph database
No comparative fastest-editor or browser INP claim; test-suite duration is not UI latency
